# JANDÉ — Once Upon A Time — full reference

Last updated: 2026-09-13
Canonical URL: https://prodbykctw-max.github.io/once-upon-a-time/

## TL;DR

Once Upon A Time is a free 8-bit side-scrolling browser game made for singer Jandé's song 'Once Upon A Time.' Help Jandé run, jump, slide and fight her way to the spotlight while The Groom Who Lied chases her through the enchanted halls. Nine stages with bosses and hidden caches; play on phone or desktop, no registration required.

Developer: PRODBYKCTW LLC (Melvin D. Brown III, @prodbyKCTW) / RARƎ AGENCY. Genre: Platformer / runner / beat 'em up. Platform: Web browser (mobile and desktop), installable PWA. Price: free.

## What it is
A promotional pixel-art game for the artist Jandé and her single "Once Upon A Time." The Groom Who Lied is chasing her — the player runs, leaps and slides through enchanted halls in two modes: side-scroll combat dash and behind-the-back corridor run. Nine stages, each with a boss and a hidden cache. Beat a boss to start fresh runs from that stage. Players can enter the Kingdom to be first to receive Jandé's release news, or play without registering.

## How to play
- Move — arrow keys or the on-screen pad · Jump over obstacles · Slide under gates · Dash through foes with SHIFT
- Move left and right between lanes in corridor runs
- On touch: swipe to move, jump and slide
- Collect coins to earn power-ups

## Tech
Vanilla JavaScript + HTML5 canvas, installable as a PWA, hosted on GitHub Pages.

## Frequently asked questions

Q: What is Once Upon A Time?
A: A free 8-bit browser game made for Jandé's song 'Once Upon A Time.' Run, jump, slide and fight through nine stages while The Groom Who Lied chases her.

Q: Do I need to register?
A: No. You can play without registering; entering the Kingdom is optional and gets you Jandé's release news first.

Q: Who made it?
A: PRODBYKCTW / RARƎ AGENCY (Melvin D. Brown III, @prodbyKCTW), an Atlanta-area developer building promotional games for artists.

Q: What are the controls?
A: Arrows or the on-screen pad to move, jump over obstacles, slide under gates, SHIFT to dash; on touch, swipe to move, jump and slide.
